snippet.title: Quality Assurance - Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Participate in chaotic testing sessions with up to eight players where you'll work together to solve a wide variety of randomized tasks while navigating hindering conditions. Prove to your creators that you're not just functional — you're exceptional.
